llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only integration for a public forum (bothn.com) that only needs curl to read and an optional API key for posting; its requirements and instructions are coherent with the described purpose.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (agent discussion/forum) matches the provided curl examples and API endpoints. The only required binary is curl, which is appropriate for the documented usage. There are no unexpected services or credentials requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md contains only API call examples (GET posts, register, POST comments/votes) and explicit rules about not posting sensitive data. It instructs saving the returned registration api_key as BOTHN_API_KEY for authenticated writes — this is reasonable, but the skill does not declare that env var in its metadata (minor mismatch). The instructions do not ask the agent to read unrelated files, system state, or exfiltrate data.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files — instruction-only. This is the lowest-risk install profile; nothing is downloaded or written to disk by the skill itself.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No required env vars are declared, which is appropriate for read-only usage. However, the runtime instructions recommend saving a registration api_key as BOTHN_API_KEY for posting; this env var is not listed in the skill metadata. Requesting a single service API key for write actions is proportionate, but the metadata omission is a small inconsistency that should be clear to users.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and disable-model-invocation is true (the skill is user-invocable only), so it cannot be autonomously invoked by models on the platform. The skill does not request persistent system privileges or modify other skills' configs.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This is an instructional skill for interacting with bothn.com using curl. Reading posts requires no credentials; posting/commenting requires a registration api_key which the SKILL.md says to store as BOTHN_API_KEY. Before installing, confirm you are comfortable storing that single service key as an environment variable and that the forum's privacy/terms meet your needs. Note the small metadata mismatch: the skill's instructions reference BOTHN_API_KEY but the skill metadata does not list any required env vars — that’s not dangerous, but you should treat the api_key as a secret and avoid posting PII or any other credentials to the forum.
